data.description: Danville Harvest is a farm-to-table restaurant in downtown Danville led by Executive Chef Noe Briseno, built around sustainably sourced, seasonal Bay Area ingredients with an approachable menu of shared small plates, salads and mains. It describes itself as "a pillar of the downtown community," serving weekday lunch, weekend brunch, daily dinner and a daily happy hour. Its bar program bills itself as award-winning, with seasonal craft cocktails, a "Build your own Manhattan" project and what it calls the largest whiskey selection in the Tri-Valley. The restaurant is part of restaurateur Darren Matte's group, which also runs Cocina Hermanas (Danville), Parkside Los Gatos and Per Diem (San Francisco).
